name: The Forge
text: No mission. +1 strength to all units here.
flavor: The anvil sings when struck.

name: The Bazaar
passive: Players with a unit here pay 1 less gold on Buy actions (minimum 1).
text: No mission. Reduced Buy costs.
flavor: Everything has a price — just not always gold.

name: Trade Port
passive: At the start of your turn gain 1 gold if you have a Diplomacy unit here.
text: No mission. Gold income with a Diplomacy unit.
flavor: Ships come and go. Gold stays.

name: The Arena
passive: Strength contests here get +1 bonus for the attacker.
text: Have a Military unit and combined strength 8+ here to complete.
flavor: The crowd demands blood.

name: Scriptorium
text: Have a Knowledge unit and combined cunning 8+ here to complete.
flavor: Every copy is a small act of preservation.

name: Town Hall
text: Have a Politics unit and combined charisma 8+ here to complete.
flavor: Every empire is governed one town at a time.

name: Temple
text: Have a Spirituality unit and combined charisma 8+ here to complete.
flavor: Offerings in. Blessings out.

name: Counting House
text: Have a Commerce unit and combined cunning 8+ here to complete.
flavor: Debit on the left. Credit on the right. Profit in between.

name: Alexandria Harbor
passive: You may look at the top card of your main deck at any time.
text: Have a Knowledge unit and a Diplomacy unit among 2+ units here to complete.
flavor: Where knowledge met commerce.

name: The Agora
text: Have a Diplomacy unit and combined charisma 12+ here to complete.
flavor: Where words were worth more than swords.

name: The Catacombs
passive: Units here cannot be injured by events.
text: Have 2 Spirituality units here to complete.
flavor: The dead protect the living.

name: The Observatory
text: Have a Knowledge unit and combined cunning 14+ here to complete.
flavor: The stars do not lie — if you know how to read them.

name: Iga Province
text: Have an Espionage unit and combined cunning 12+ here to complete.
flavor: Its mountain families learned to move unseen.

name: Globe Theatre
text: Have a Culture unit among 3+ units here to complete.
flavor: All the world's a stage.

name: Sagres
text: Have 2 Exploration units here to complete.
flavor: Charts drawn at the edge of the known world.

name: Grand Canal
text: Have an Engineering unit and combined strength 14+ here to complete.
flavor: A river dug by hand from Hangzhou to Beijing.

name: Venetian Arsenal
text: Have an Engineering unit and a Military unit here to complete.
flavor: It could fit out a war galley in a single day.

name: Sherwood Forest
passive: Units here with 7+ cunning cannot be targeted by strength contests.
text: No mission. Units here with 7+ cunning cannot be targeted by strength contests.
flavor: The trees keep secrets.

name: The Great Library
text: Have 2 Knowledge units and combined cunning 16+ here to complete.
flavor: Knowledge is the only treasure that multiplies when shared.

name: The Colosseum
text: Have 2 Military units and combined strength 18+ here to complete.
flavor: The sand remembers every name.

name: The Silk Road
passive: At the start of your turn gain 1 gold if you have a unit here.
text: Have a Commerce unit and a Diplomacy unit and a Knowledge unit among 3+ units here to complete.
flavor: A thread that stitched the world together.

name: Versailles
text: Have a Politics unit and combined charisma 20+ here to complete.
flavor: Excess as a form of government.

name: The Pyramids
text: Have 5 units here to complete.
flavor: Built to outlast memory itself.

name: The Great Wall
text: No mission. Blocked to the north and south. Units defending here get +2 strength in contests.
flavor: They could not go over it.
